name: SoftDOS
description: An x86 PC emulator written in .logic: a 16/32-bit CPU with the full 386 integer instruction set, VGA text and mode 13h including unchained Mode X and the graphics controller, a BIOS, DOS kernel with a writable drive, DPMI host, mouse driver and real interrupt delivery, and a command line. Drop a game's files or its zip on drive C and run it: DOOM, Jill of the Jungle, and MS-DOS programs of their era.
author: SoftN
